## Sole NIGHTLY Pages publisher R9: exact prepared candidate checked; two local-file memory-admission negatives REPRODUCED — NO PUBLICATION

**Immutable source:** website `main@5d1cf4db62f8700da7671b6b44a6c7dea989228c`, complete root `2aae49f1c4835733a21c7d98727dfbcc7f371df5`, reviewed PR10 final head `aeff10622163cb1a7e05eee89238352e9ca0bf71`. Actual private MAIN-Library prepared packet `LoopyX0X37-PR10-aeff106-Final-Publisher-Packet-20261024.zip`, **330026 bytes** SHA256 `bb1175e459a0484969acd5779feade28487d03d2ae1043d7248e2e0bb3020f59`; exact extracted generated `install/index.html`, **124644 bytes** SHA256 `152e56f49f383dd69fa079e27477febb629d41ddbdd79d8160b05a56594249ba`. This is the unmodified, controller-free candidate, not hosted by Pages.

**Executed Node v22.16.0 against actual generated function bodies** (not mocks replacing the function):
1. `node run9_stream_read_exact_source.mjs` exit **0**, **14/14 PASS** for real `readApprovedPackage` with synthetic response streams: exact/short/oversized chunks, no stream, wrong chunk type, stale selection, thrown read, cancellation and locking. Scoped native source replay only; not Chromium or HTTPS.
2. `node run9_local_upload_bounds_repro.mjs` exit **0** with **2 expected-negative FAILURES REPRODUCED**: generated `ctlfile` change handler and `selectStockFile` each call `File.arrayBuffer()` for a `File` reporting `size=1073741824` (1 GiB) **before checking any file-size bound**. The fake files returned 1 byte; no large allocation, actual browser exploit, firmware write or private data use occurred. Controller's later `ctlProblem(raw)` and stock's later `acceptStock(raw)` cannot prevent the earlier unbounded allocation. Reproducer extracted the exact handler bodies directly from the hash-pinned generated HTML with VM shims only for DOM/File. This is a browser memory/availability guard, not a cross-model-flash proof. Related PR9 issue was already surfaced by firmware installer R27 [compatibility handoff](https://github.com/gobbajogger/x0x37-for-Loopy-Pro_nightly/pull/9#issuecomment-6386833289); **do not spawn duplicate producers**. New scope here is the already merged candidate output.

**Proposed existing-owner fix:** before any `f.arrayBuffer()`, validate finite/safe nonzero `File.size`, enforce the controller's tight 64 KiB image size bound, and bound owner-supplied stock package bytes (existing firmware PR102 uses 16 MiB upper bound). Add true generated HTML/browser negative tests with an overlarge synthetic File and legitimate small-file controls. Existing website source producer owns correction on authorized isolated branch; independent Website QA owns whole real-package browser/controller/backup/OTA acceptance; sole Website Main Merger owns any merge. These are not self-approved by publisher.

**Remote publication state rechecked:** website `gh-pages@9c5d3b6b0846f89436492851fef89ed3829b7ad7`, tree `8cd8dc63015b94fc47baa8bba4cd17d47fa00eea`, `versions.json` Git blob `01f9ec382878335ea9bb92d0bdf294483111de76`, `latest:null;versions:[]`—**zero selectable versions**. Firmwares are externally staged separately as controller-free BUILD_ONLY artifacts (Elite SHA `d14877d6592e6dc158460e960ac5aefd1b2b775588b9f896d3c83f672d61c86c`; Pro SHA `cde289d422b61ee8b1f0a9f04ca92d244f07856667c85d757b9563e0479d3f3c`) but this runtime's Pages HTTPS HEAD attempts returned **curl exit 6 / HTTP 000 / DNS unresolved**. No served site/Elite/Pro bytes or browser pass claimed.

**Disposition:** `PUBLISHER_NO_GO`, source-only regression reported; independent real-package browser QA plus live TLS/CORS/size/SHA publisher re-GET remain pending. No public binaries, controller, private qualification, git branch changes, device flash, Pages deployment, or scheduler changes.
